review_notes.evidence: BT lower pin �05 candidate B05; BR main input �04 candidate B04. BZ printed bottom identifier is eroded and resembles E2; retain �� rather than infer BZ, although the connector table legibly labels BZ4. Internal graph ID BZ is bookkeeping only. BV first function glyph has lost its top; �R retained, candidate OR. Exact paired native root/KT271 KT711BX4 native pair.png clearly shows outlined◇ in BX connective 3-5◇6; root independently agrees.
Native card first digit is damaged: �350E1 retained. Candidate 1350E1 from surviving narrow stroke; A1 supports 3350E1 but cannot restore missing native print without approval.

Every gate, source, pin and route individually inspected. BM output rises c153 from r68 to r56 and feeds BL.B09. CA output r61 and BV lower output r65 cross this BM vertical without diamonds and remain unjoined. BZ output diamond feeds CB.B09 and CA.B04. AK drives BR and SCAN13L. BLOCK EC4 drives AD.D05 and BQ.B12. LEFT A drives AK.B07 and BU.B10. BR output returns to AL.B03. AH output rises c108 from r61 to r47, then c131 to r42 and feeds BH.D05, avoiding BD body. AM output drops c115 to r45, returns via c176 to r42; its reference diamond is c203/r42. Native output rows are40/42/44/46/54/61/65/82. All block columns remain normal.

Independent root ink misses prompted enlarged native inspection: BZ branch diamond and vertical alignc133 (not136), GATE PTY turn aligns directlywithinputterminalc115 (not114), BW main descent aligns c135 (not136). No block bank shift; nativecalibrated route corrections. Evidence KT711 BZ branch native correction.png and KT711 PTY channels native correction.png.
